title: Choose Limbo's visual world
question: The roll assigned "The Waiting Room". Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Waiting Room
options.lineage: the literal limbo: an ash-grey antechamber between worlds
options.thesis: Every request waits in limbo until you look at it: unseen ones glow, opened ones settle.
options.viewport: Ash room; endpoints as doors in the left rail; requests condense out of haze into the list with an ember mark until opened; the open request sits in a bone-lit plate.
options.risk: The metaphor turns to costume fast; haze must never blur data.

raised.raise: Payload size rides a fixed magnitude ramp: a dot whose diameter is the size class, scannable down the list.
Each endpoint keeps fixed furniture: name plate, born date, and its one-line answer (status · type).
The layout grid stays visible as hairline structure across list and detail.

options.label: Flight Progress Strips
options.thesis: Each request is a strip slotted into its endpoint's bay; you work the traffic like a controller.
options.viewport: Dark console; a bay of strips newest on top with ruled boxes METHOD | PATH | TIME | SIZE | ORIGIN; the pulled strip opens right as the working strip.
options.risk: Topped my own list; strip skeuomorphism reads as costume unless every box is functional.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The request as pure signal: bytes, bars and numbers in black and white, inverting for one frame when something lands.
options.viewport: Black field; a dense monospace request column, each row carrying a barcode drawn from its own bytes; the selected request inverts to white; hex and headers in tabular columns.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: payloads are data, the byte-barcode is a true fingerprint, inversion makes arrival unmissable. Beats the roll on audience and clarity.
options.risk: No color left for method or status; strobing must stop under reduced motion.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Every capture is a coupon; states stamp themselves: TRUNCATED, BINARY, VOID.
options.viewport: Navy wallet; endpoints as tabbed coupon books; the open request as a ruled coupon with carbon-struck fields.
options.case: Stamps map cleanly onto truncation, binary and deleted states; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Paper nostalgia on a dense dev tool can read theme-park.

options.label: Lexicon & Plates
options.thesis: Requests set like dictionary entries; untrusted payloads quarantined in bordered plates; guide words name the span in view.
options.viewport: Two guide timestamps head the request column (first and last in view); the payload sits in a bordered plate like a lithograph.
options.case: Quarantine plates make 'untrusted stays inert' visible; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: A bookish world fights a dark, dense developer tool.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Arrivals plotted as stars, payload size as magnitude.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a sky chart hides the list the task needs.
options.kept: A fixed magnitude ramp for payload size.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Endpoints as a ranked cast of characters.
options.case: Fuses poorly on both axes for a debugging tool.
options.kept: Fixed furniture per endpoint: name plate, born date, one-line answer.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The slug built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: Monumental grid lettering over a small grotesk.
options.case: Loses both axes: display type has no job in an inspector.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A neutral dark three-pane inspector in the DevTools tradition, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Endpoint sidebar, request list, tabbed detail; one blue accent for selection.
